title: Describe a Learning Experience

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

instructions: Write your own response. The example is for study and is not a submission.
prompt: Write 120–180 words to a fictional mentor about a skill you have practiced. Describe a finished event last week, say how long you have worked on the skill, and request one specific suggestion. Use at least six lesson words.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: 介绍目标和练习；用一般过去时说明上周的具体事情；用 since 或 for 说明仍在持续的学习；最后请求具体反馈，不把练习承诺成就业。

reference: Dear Sara, I am writing about the progress I have made in our skills session. I have practiced a welcome message for two months, and I have worked with a mentor since April. On Tuesday last week my tutor read the first version and gave me feedback about the room name. I changed the notice after the meeting and added a clear time. My next objective is to explain the message without reading every word. I feel more confident, but I still need to practice a longer question. The apprentice can assist me during the next shift, and the instructor will supervise the exercise. Could you give me one practical suggestion about the order of my points? I will keep both versions in my portfolio so that I can see the improvement. I know that this practice does not promise employment.
referenceLabel: 原创示例，仅供学习；不要作为自己的待提交作文。
